objective: Test fixed-q0 independent observation-derived G increment before any new TTA complexity.
scope: Single frozen Waymo-only grounder, fixed originalq0/nativeyaw0, no new training/teacher/EMA. Drone2/Quad3 scenes; targetVAL prior research-exposed, exploratory. Old rounds immutable. R10 excludes all R9 IDs/pointpaths, so no R9GTsidecar reuse; postseal R5annotationindex required.

minimal_arm_roles.source: Matched originalq0 raw6 baseline, no geometry correction.
minimal_arm_roles.full_rgb: Observation-derived geometry with RGB coordinate constraint.
minimal_arm_roles.no_rgb_coordinate: Same inputpoints/q0/point-support mask/observations/accepted axes/globalgate as full; remove only RGB coordinate constraint. This control still inherits RGB pointmask/gate and is NOT purePC deployment.
minimal_arm_roles.rgb_pointmask_ablated: Remove RGB pointmask and rebuild point geometry. This changes observations/coverage; report it separately and compare on GT-free common masks as well as all. It is not the same intervention as removing coordinate constraint.

matching.coordinate_pair: Exact same point file/sampling indices/source cache/q0 and point support IDs; final accepted-axis arrays bitexact, global gate identical. Only constraint operation differs. If raw eligibility differs, predeclared shared acceptance envelope is applied to BOTH; raw eligibility and lost coverage retained.
matching.pointmask_pair: Exact same initial rawP/q0/camera/text/source; changed observed support explicitly recorded. No claim sameinformation when point subsets differ. If it inherits full acceptance, name RGB-gated pointmask ablation, not purePC deployable baseline.
matching.source_prior: A single nearplane center constraint depends on source half-size; mark mixed point_plane_plus_source_size_prior, never pure observed center. Unchanged source dimension is not observed size.
matching.no_GT: No true bbox/class/positive-map/identity in G or GPU manifest. GT read only after complete prediction+source/code/manifest seal and parent CPU release.

primary_metrics.all: Perplatform selected nativeyaw0 meanIoU,strict Acc25/50,centerL2m,sizeL2m and both coordinate-block abs errors; n/scene count,failed/skipped explicit.
primary_metrics.changed: Own actualfloat32changed subset descriptive only; paired primary common set is UNION of delivered full/noRGBcoordinate changed flags, applied to source and both arms. Also report intersection and GT-free common eligible, each with exact n. Never compare means over each arm own changed populations as causal gain.
primary_metrics.pointmask_commoncoverage: Pairwise GT-free intersection of eligible axes/cases and unionchanged, identical mask applied to both source and arms. All-case metrics retain coverage effects; commoncase does not ensure point observations same.
primary_metrics.signed: For each contrast, gains/harms/ties atIoU1e-8; center/size error sign at1e-6m; mean,positive/negative sums,max harm and all signedtails retained privately. Separate exactzeros from tolerance ties.
primary_metrics.size_yaw: GT local yaw dimension parameter error is not exact nativeyaw0 global enclosing size. Do not claim GTdimensions maximize IoU.
primary_metrics.provenance: Percoordinate independent observation basis, observed-side support, bound source and sourceprior use required. Support/reliability does not itself prove correctness.

conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.engineering: Valid newpoint-derived estimates/nonzero correction, matched coordinate intervention and inverseprojection/visibility passed, noGT path, all arms sealed then audited.
conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.pseudo_evidence: Root proposed gate: positive paired taskIoU AND positive actual fitted coordinate-block error improvement vs source and matched noRGBcoordinate, fullall and same-maskunionchanged reported. Positive gain sums exceed absolute harm sums rather than just large correction magnitude. Numerical error budget prelocked; do not treat optimization loss or tiny roundoff as pseudo-quality. 2/3scene descriptive only, no significance claim.
conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.scope: If only one platform/one scene supports the gain, restrict follow-up claim to that measured condition; do not silently pool or select new thresholds. If RGB coordinate constraint adds nothing, report geometry-only contribution, not RGB mechanism success.
conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.next_only_if_pseudo_improves: Propose separately locked cross-observation study: derive stopgradient target from observationA, adapt on inputB with disjoint rawpoint IDs/view, evaluate heldout inputC/observation. No sameinput fit to its own target as method benefit. Fresh source/direct-target/no-update and exactoutput-space controls matched.
conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.disjoint_limit: A/B point split of same scan is disjoint observations but not independent sensor view/time. Split physical/rawpointIDs before replacement sampling, audit duplicate coordinates/rays; if no separate view/registration exists do not promise it. Temporal/view correspondence cannot be assumed without pose/object association evidence.
conditional_progression_proposal_not_yet.no_automatic_execution: Current authorization is G test only. No optimizer sweep/online stream/new heavybranch scheduled from this draft.
